item.title: [LOW] The AI Agent Nobody Owns: Watch Expert Webinar On Your Newest Insider Threat
item.description: Right now, there is probably an AI agent running on a laptop somewhere in your network. item.description: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.
